projects.name: FanNest
projects.desc: A full Shopify anime-merch storefront — theme build, product catalogue, pricing rules and an automated Instagram/Facebook Reels pipeline that sources product media, prices it in USD and posts on a schedule without duplicating a listing.

projects.name: Aufan Week Board
projects.desc: A public departures-board style site showing my real weekly availability, pulled live from Google Calendar, with a booking request flow that emails me and blocks the slot on approval. Cut manual back-and-forth to near zero.

projects.name: baka nae.
projects.desc: Brand showcase site for my sister's anime fanart label — 10.7k Shopee followers, 7.4k five-star reviews. Bilingual ID/EN, live catalogue filtering and sorting, built as a credibility flagship that hands checkout back to Shopee.

projects.name: Pixel Dungeon Knight
projects.desc: Browser and mobile roguelike dungeon shooter built end to end: 18 characters with two skills each, 136 weapons, 15 attachments, 9 pets, 98 enemies, 28 bosses, 17 biomes, plus Boss Rush and hidden vaults.

projects.name: Untitled Game
projects.desc: Co-op 3D pixel-art adventure in Unity, built with a partner. Where I learned to actually measure a game instead of guessing — combat balance work cut time-per-kill from 8.0s to 2.2s after instrumenting it.

projects.name: Hollowborne
projects.desc: Browser action-RPG with an original story bible — combat, progression and world design written before a line of engine code.

projects.name: AgentSentry
projects.desc: A kill-switch proxy for AI agents: sits between an agent and the APIs it calls, logs every request, and lets a human cut it off mid-run. Built as a Next.js dashboard around a SaaS idea.

projects.name: FreshTrack
projects.desc: Mobile food-freshness tracker — point the camera at what's in the fridge and get a shelf-life estimate before it goes to waste.

projects.name: Motion Graphics Pipeline
projects.desc: Vertical 9:16 explainer videos built in Remotion — code-driven scenes with sound effects timed frame-accurately to the animation rather than eyeballed in an editor.
